name: Emmanuel Longa
headline: Working on Something New | Ex-BCG | Former ClimateTech Founder | Scaling Teams, Processes & Digital Products
summary:
A curious problem-solver with a love for people, nature and tech.

I am a product, strategy and operations leader with 7+ years of experience across consulting (BCG), startup founding, and high-growth tech environments.

My work focuses on connecting business strategy, product thinking, and technical execution to help organizations scale efficiently and deliver best-in-class digital experiences. I enjoy leading multidisciplinary teams, designing customer-centric solutions, and building the processes and structures that enable sustainable growth. I thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments where strategy, product, and operations intersect.

Interested in new connections and experiences aligned with the three core principles which guide my work:
  /  Why - shaping a greener, safer and better-educated future for all
  /  How - empathy, questioning the status quo and creativity
  /  What - design of products, services and organizations

positions.title: Head of Solutions
positions.description:
At Idwall, we build digital identity and fraud prevention solutions that enable companies to verify and onboard individuals and businesses — with safety, scalability, and great user experience.

As Head of Solutions, I lead the team responsible for ensuring clients discover and successfully integrate the best Idwall solutions for their needs.

My role includes:

- Build and mentor a high-performing team of 6 solution consultants, growing their technical fluency, consultative skills, and ownership
- Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise clients, securing enterprise deals which generated over 15 % increase in company revenue in my first 6 months.
- Increased proposal conversion rate from 19% to 35% by standardizing materials, introducing activity-level
tracking, and implementing tiered support models.
- Designed and standardized GTM flows, achieving an 50% reduction in time-to-solution for SMB clients.
- Act as a strategic bridge between clients and product teams, ensuring client needs are translated into impactful, scalable solutions
- Develop and scale internal processes across discovery, proof of concept, integration, and go-live - reducing time-to-value and improving delivery quality
- Establish and track operational metrics and SLAs to monitor performance, team workload, and delivery excellence
- Leverage client feedback and market trends to influence Idwall’s product roadmap, prioritizing features with highest impact on revenue and customer retention
- Evolve idwall's go‑to‑market strategy in partnership with Sales and Marketing, bringing market and customer insights to improve our value proposition and targeting (e.g. fintechs, marketplaces)

positions.title: CEO / Founder
positions.description:
At Compensa, we empower your company to be a leader in environmental sustainability by combining  environmental consulting with a best-in-class emissions management software.

As Compensa's Co-founder and CEO, I was responsible for:

- Defining the vision and strategy that guided the company’s growth and impact.
- Designing and launching a full carbon management SaaS platform, reaching over 1,700 registered companies and achieving an average of 100 daily active users.
- Achieving 7x revenue growth from Year 2 to Year 3 and break-even on Year 3.
- Leading a cross-functional team of 10 (design, engineering, sustainability specialists) to develop and scale our SaaS platform
- Raising $500k in pre-seed funding from institutional investors (Rocket Internet / GFC funded)
